criteria: Freeze unrelated development; preserve current refs and evidence; inventory concurrent agents/schedules, without unauthorized cancellation.
Inventory all branches with exact SHA, purpose, dependencies, open PRs, ownership evidence, keep/archive/retire proposal. No deletion or default-branch changes without exact approval.

Account for all 173 engineering commits at baseline with exact parent/ancestry, changed paths, purpose, associated issue and disposition; inspect substantive diffs, excluded/experimental material, secrets/provenance, workflows and historical evidence. Report unreviewed items honestly.

Reconcile all 42 bindings individually against GitHub issue status, fix/candidate/merge evidence, target inclusion and historical authorization. Do not rewrite original records or bulk mark deferred as integrated.
Decide which permanent branches are necessary, including self-install versus source; distinguish template branches and archive refs from working branches.

Implement law in authoritative engineering and portable package rules, state/preflight/claim/finish/recovery checks and reporting; maintain compatible state or explicitly reviewed migration, fail closed on missing/stale evidence. Document ownership and expiry of deferrals; no mandatory branch protection, external services, paid runners or hard enforcement.

Prepare exact safe main candidate and manifest of included/excluded files/commits; preserve history, license/provenance, approved brand restrictions, #37/#40/#53 holds; no release tag, deployment, brand rollout or experimental activation. Review workflow triggers before main integration; do not merge live adopter ledgers or private diagnostics.

Bounded regression coverage on standard free public GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and Windows: placeholder default, wrong target, non-main default, valid documented alternate target, stale/expired/unapproved deferral, stale lease, accepted integration evidence, engineering-only closure, existing installations/upgrades, interruption and partial synchronization; clean and existing consumer fixtures, Graphify mapping, exact-head CodeRabbit and Internal Auditor review. No advanced independent host campaigns.

Obtain separate explicit owner approval of corrected architecture and exact integration candidate/base/head/tree; resolve existing integration holds explicitly. Preserve history with reviewed non-force integration.
Integrate only approved software into designated product branch; verify actual post-merge CI and exact tree/ancestry. Stop on mismatch; prepare safe forward correction, no force reset.

Append canonical dispositions and reconcile actual GitHub state, installed package pin and issue-specific evidence; preserve historical mappings and archives. Qualify upgrade plan before any external repository writes; read-only adopter inventory may identify exposure.

Obtain Head acceptance, close only with verified receipt and owner authority; release slot and resume agent instructions (proposed .44) and README HQ (proposed .45) in sequence. No stable release or commercial launch inferred.
